thread:
sofia: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — recurring 99th pct latency spikes on /generate. Need owners and concrete timelines for the action items we agreed on.

mike: I can take the batching config task. Will validate default batch window + add sampling. ETA: EOD Wednesday.

jae: I'll pick up the dashboard/alert tuning. Current alerts are too noisy. Planning to add an error-budget burn panel and split the 95/99 alerts. ETA: Thursday.

oncall-bot: Deploy complete: rollout/opt-batcher v2 -> prod at 2026-03-22T23:12:03Z (sha: a1b2c3).

sofia: Thanks. Two extra things: 1) We need a short-term SLO tweak proposal (temporary 99th pct window relax?) and 2) cross-team communication plan so product notices if throughput changes affect SLAs.

carmen: For SLO tweak — propose a targeted 7-day temporary adjustment for the traffic spike cohort only (requests with header X-Model: large). Reason: avoids global SLO drift. Will draft RFC. ETA: Friday morning.

mike: On batching, noted heavy tail for sequence length > 1024. Plan: enforce a separate queue for long sequences and cap batching. Patch PR is up: https://git.internal/r/redwood/opt-batcher/pulls/42

jae: Dashboard plan: add panels: 1) 99th latency by model+route, 2) error budget burn rate, 3) throughput vs container CPU. Alert rules:
```
alert: High99Latency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route)) > 1.2
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
```
I'll test this in staging first.

sofia: Good. Also add a simple runbook snippet to the alert description with the common mitigations: scale dedicated pool, route to cheaper variant, enable prefix cache.

carmen: RFC draft: https://docs.internal/r/redwood/slo/temporary-latency-adjust.md — includes cohort definition, rollback criteria, and communication template to CS/PMs.

mike: Quick note on timelines — after batching PR merges, I'll run a 24h canary with 10% traffic then ramp. ETA for canary end: Friday night.

jae: After alert tuning in staging I'll create a dashboard link and post it here. Expect that by Friday midday.

sofia: Ownership summary for the thread: batching config + canary = mike; alerts + dashboard = jae; SLO cohort + RFC = carmen. I'll own the cross-team comms and tracking. Please put tasks in the incident board with dates.

mike: Added tasks to board (Incident #6721) and linked PR + canary plan.

jae: Dashboard link posted: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd1234/latency-burn (staging view).

sofia: Great. Weekly check-in scheduled for next Tue 11:00 to verify error-budget trajectory and canary results. If anything pages between now and then, mark the incident as "recurrent-spike" tag so we can aggregate. :white_check_mark:

carmen: Will monitor and send status update in 48h.

sofia: Thanks everyone — let's keep the thread updated with blocking items.
